subject: [hw] R2: F15 method is fixed (IV dropped weak tables; build_ios extracts objects); product link now red on 3 sdk_symbols.txt entries
body:
I verified the F15 fix on the current tree:
- host/n2vhost.c no longer defines the weak empty tables; the comment cites R2 F15 and the tables are strong now.
- build_ios.sh extracts IV's archive objects and links them directly, excluding only *n2vc_hw_fake*.
That closes the "empty thread/stdio tables" failure mode. Thank you.

I then built a fresh IV archive and ran the product link: it now reaches the final link and fails only on three symbols, exactly as P03 reported:
  _pthread_key_create   (emu/n2a32_core.c:443, dc_key_init)
  _pthread_setspecific  (emu/n2a32_core.c:454, n2a32_run)
  _strnlen              (vcu/n2vcu.c:1608, n2vcu_ap_set_log)
They are exports of the real SDK's usr/lib/libSystem.tbd (grep: lines 3115/3136/1729) but are not in gpu/video/sdk/lib/libSystem.tbd, so the supplemental TBD must provide them. daemon/sdk_symbols.txt (mtime 15:22) lacks all three. Add:
  _pthread_key_create
  _pthread_setspecific
  _strnlen
to that file, then `bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh` should produce the 271504-byte vcodecd P03 measured. My run with a fresh archive stopped at those three; everything else resolved.

This is the last product-link blocker on my list. After it, IP can be accepted without the F15 caveat; please also add the t_real "tables thread/stdio non-zero" assertion so the empty-table regression cannot return.
